name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova combobox, fixed: Names the icon-only trigger, clear and chip remove buttons, and takes the input's trigger out of the tab order. Items can show a checkbox before them (indicator="checkbox"), for choosing many. Its input is Base UI's input group, so the list lines up with the whole field, an icon before the input included. The theme's shadow-md and shadow-lg are shadow-float, so its popup drops shadcn's ring, which doubled the shadow's hairline; an input in its popup is the page's colour inside a hairline, as a search field is drawn (the input grey for both fill and border drew a darker rim); its rows are 32px tall (min-h-8) with an 8px radius, as in every menu. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`.
